note: Both texts are complete; the leaf prints 'Au-ctrice', which X keeps and Y gives as 'Autrice' (Y also has 'Differentiis' for 'Differentijs'), both minor.

Y gives a coherent expanded reading ('dirkimen .i. in mane cum sirupo acetoso'), while X is largely garbled abbreviation ('diu tam. i. m. mane', 'r. em plumi. dirk mueru') that would mislead a reader.
Y misreads long s in 'amara, falsa' (the leaf has 'salsa') and 'illapfus', and adds cut-off fragments of the facing page as margins; X matches the leaf.
X drops the passage 'sentire. Circa Romã inuenitur genus quoddam parui lacerti, dorso per totum stellato, quod terrantulam' (line 10-11), which Y has.
The leaf prints page '561', 'Esa. 57. v. 55' and 'Offenb. 1. v.' with no number; X changes these to '161', 'v. 15' and 'v. 8', and modernises 'Gebuhrt' and 'kurtzer'.
X keeps the printed 'Saltz', 'geschmoltzen', 'gantz', 'præpariret', which Y modernises to 'Salz', 'ganz', 'präpariret'; the wording is otherwise the same.

The leaf reads 'lettere [struck] quasi infinite' with 'in quelle' written above the struck 'nelle lor lettere'; Y invents 'et <unclear>punti</unclear> infiniti' and leaves out the inserted 'in quelle'.

X records only what is visible past the gutter; Y garbles the text ('à periculo se inuicem procellis. Atq; etiam numerant hos fluctus', which drops 'nauigantibus, qui semper post unius impulsum') and rewrites the Greek ('τὰς ἐλπίδας οἷα' where the leaf has 'ἕως ... διὰ').
X matches the leaf's 'Rotz', 'saltzichten', 'nitrosischen'; Y misreads these as 'Roß' and 'nitrofischen' (long s) and modernises to 'salzichten', but the sense stays recoverable.
Y matches the leaf in 'وتجربة', 'الطلاسم وهى الناشرة' and 'بالتعاديل', where X has 'وتجرية', 'التاشيرة' and 'بالتعادل'; both are otherwise complete.
